441: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("EnsureNextCriticalHit",

444:     # Useless if the user's critical hit stage ensures critical hits already, or

453:       crit_stage = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromUser(user.battler.item,

457:       crit_stage += user.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy]
458:       crit_stage = [crit_stage, Battle::Move::CRITICAL_HIT_RATIOS.length - 1].min

751: Battle::AI::Handlers::MoveEffectScore.add("ProtectUser",
752:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
753:     # Useless if the success chance is 25% or lower
754:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] >= 4
755:     # Score changes for each foe
756:     useless = true
757:     ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
758:       next if !b.can_attack?
759:       next if !b.check_for_move { |m| m.canProtectAgainst? }
760:       next if b.has_active_ability?(:UNSEENFIST) && b.check_for_move { |m| m.contactMove? }
761:       useless = false
762:       # General preference
763:       score += 7
764:       # Prefer if the foe is in the middle of using a two turn attack
765:       score += 15 if b.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack] &&
766:                      GameData::Move.get(b.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack]).flags.any? { |f| f[/^CanProtect$/i] }
767:       # Prefer if foe takes EOR damage, don't prefer if they have EOR healing
768:       b_eor_damage = b.rough_end_of_round_damage
769:       if b_eor_damage > 0
770:         score += 8
771:       elsif b_eor_damage < 0
772:         score -= 8
773:       end
774:     end
775:     next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE if useless
776:     # Prefer if the user has EOR healing, don't prefer if they take EOR damage
777:     user_eor_damage = user.rough_end_of_round_damage
778:     if user_eor_damage >= user.hp
779:       next Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
780:     elsif user_eor_damage > 0
781:       score -= 8
782:     elsif user_eor_damage < 0
783:       score += 8
784:     end
785:     # Don't prefer if the user used a protection move last turn, making this one
786:     # less likely to work
787:     score -= (user.effects[PBEffects::ProtectRate] - 1) * ((Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? 15 : 10)
788:     next score
789:   }
